stem.en: Two compounds in a mixture have very similar molecular weights but separate cleanly on a chromatography column. What does this most directly indicate?
stem.et: Kahel segu ühendil on väga sarnased molekulmassid, kuid need eralduvad kromatograafiakolonnil puhtalt. Mida see kõige otsesemalt näitab?

label.en: The two compounds have substantially different relative affinities for the stationary phase versus the mobile phase, which is what actually drives chromatographic separation, not molecular weight.
label.et: Kahel ühendil on oluliselt erinev suhteline afiinsus statsionaarse faasi versus liikuva faasi suhtes, mis ongi see, mis tegelikult juhib kromatograafilist eraldumist, mitte molekulmass.

label.en: This result is actually impossible, since chromatography separates compounds directly by molecular weight, so similar-weight compounds should always co-elute.
label.et: See tulemus on tegelikult võimatu, kuna kromatograafia eraldab ühendeid otseselt molekulmassi järgi, seega peaksid sarnase massiga ühendid alati koos eralduma.

label.en: Both compounds must have already been individually identified beforehand, since chromatography can only confirm the presence of known, previously identified compounds.
label.et: Mõlemad ühendid peavad olema juba eelnevalt individuaalselt identifitseeritud, kuna kromatograafia saab ainult kinnitada teadaolevate, eelnevalt identifitseeritud ühendite olemasolu.

label.en: This particular separation must be using a fundamentally different mechanism than other chromatographic techniques, since ordinary chromatography cannot separate similar-weight compounds.
label.et: See konkreetne eraldumine peab kasutama fundamentaalselt erinevat mehhanismi kui teised kromatograafilised tehnikad, kuna tavaline kromatograafia ei suuda eraldada sarnase massiga ühendeid.
